Topline: inbound via Drift demo request from CTO of CadenceFold (sales enablement plugin). SMB, building meeting-summary and rep-coaching features. Wants to start on Hosted API (self-serve) to iterate quickly, potential to convert to Dedicated later if volume grows. Technical constraints/ask: PII handling — call transcripts contain names, emails, credit-card snippets — wants default automatic PII redaction for summaries OR clear guidance on retention TTLs. Asked: 30-day rolling retention = ok? Also wants delete-on-demand API and per-customer KMS support if they scale. Quoted: "We can't store raw audio/transcripts >30d without a deletion flow — compliance ask from customers." 

Recent timeline:
- 2026-03-02: Intro call (ff_20260302_872). AE Avery + SE Ravi. Demo of Redwood hosted API quickstart. AE note: good technical curiosity, want low-friction signup.
- 2026-03-04: Follow-up email with hosted_api pricing link (thread:175f3a9c). Provided sample curl, streaming example.

Latency target: <300ms partial for streaming snippets, end-to-end summary under 2s for short calls. Throughput: initially low (10-50 calls/day), could scale to 500/day in 6-9 months. Cost sensitivity high; interested in model recommendations for cost/quality tradeoffs.

POC asks / success metrics:
- Ingest 2 weeks of anonymized transcripts (demo dataset) into Hosted API.
- Validate delete-on-demand API works within SLA (24h confirmation).
- Demo retention TTL options: 7d, 30d, 90d. Default = 30d for POC.
- Confirm SSO + audit logging for team access to console (read-only for ops).

Next steps: SE to send POC checklist + sample curl + short privacy FAQ by 2026-03-12. Blockers: need formal written statement for retention + KMS options before POC can ingest real customer data. Pricing note: likely self-serve with monthly invoice ~1k-3k if usage stays low.

Internal notes: keep cadence light. High conversion probability if POC goes smooth and retention + delete-on-demand are clearly documented. Consider offering 90-day credit or trial tokens to reduce friction.
